about: The disc images the releases were baked from and tested with (bake.py, fingerprint). A bake from any other image still runs; its stamp (halo/bake.txt) and log say it isn't one of these. Each entry: the image's name as its owner had it, its SHA-1 (whole file), default.xbe's SHA-256, the title record's version, and the builds tested with it.

images.name: Halo - Combat Evolved (USA) (Rev 2).xiso.iso
images.note: an xiso (the Xbox file system repacked, not the raw disc), so its SHA-1, MD5 and CRC32 are its own, not a disc-preservation database's; default.xbe's hash and title record match any copy of the same disc
